# Lifecycle Recovery Checklist: 002-task-lifecycle-recovery

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for soft-delete (HU-05), reopen (HU-06), and password recovery (HU-14) — completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the written requirements
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are soft-delete preservation requirements defined, prohibiting physical deletion and retaining task record plus prior audit history? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are default-exclusion requirements for soft-deleted tasks from active listings and pending counts explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are audit-event content requirements (actor, action, entity, UTC timestamp) defined for `TASK_DELETED` and `TASK_REOPENED`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are single-use, 60-minute expiry, and rotation-invalidation requirements for recovery tokens all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are secure-storage requirements (hash-only passwords, hash-only tokens, zero plaintext in DB and audit logs) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are cross-user authorization requirements for delete and reopen operations defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the "neutral response" for password-reset requests quantified with exact message text and HTTP status for both existing and non-existing emails? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are the "same validations as registration" for the new password clarified with explicit length and non-empty rules rather than by reference alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the reopen target state explicitly defined as "pendiente" (vs. "en progreso" or generic "activo")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "homogeneous response time" for anti-enumeration quantified with a measurable threshold or method? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are rejection codes for operations on soft-deleted tasks consistent (404 vs. 400) across double-delete, edit/status blocking, reopen blocking, and direct-ID reads? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are authorization-failure codes consistent (403 vs. 404) between user-story scenarios and FR-021 without leaking ownership? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the `TASK_REOPENED` vs. `STATUS_CHANGED` vs. `TASK_CREATED` distinction consistently defined across functional requirements, entities, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the 60-minute expiry consistently defined across acceptance scenarios, FR-013, assumptions, and SC-005? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 - Can SC-001 ("100% disappear immediately, 100% records retained") be objectively measured, with "immediately" and "default listing scope" defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 - Can SC-004 ("0% email leakage including timing") be objectively verified with a defined measurement method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are token-invalidation success criteria measurable for all triggers (first use, 60-min expiry, rotation by newer token)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is SC-006 ("zero plaintext") scoped to all persistence surfaces (DB, audit logs, console simulation, error traces)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 - Are double-delete requirements defined, requiring controlled error with no data mutation and no duplicate audit? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are concurrent-reopen requirements defined (single `TASK_REOPENED`, clean handling of the losing request)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are direct-ID read requirements for soft-deleted tasks by standard users specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are post-reset session-invalidation requirements specified for all prior active sessions? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are multi-request rotation requirements defined (prior live tokens auto-invalidated on new request)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 - Are malformed, truncated, empty, or manipulated token requirements defined, requiring safe rejection without internal-error disclosure? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are new-password format and strength failure requirements defined for the reset-confirm path? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are dev-environment email-simulation requirements defined without exposing token secrets publicly? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 - Are token-security NFRs (cryptographically secure, random, single-use) quantified or referenced to a generation standard? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are audit-immutability requirements defined for deleted-task history and prior events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the Increment 1 dependency (registration, login, create/list/status/edit in production) validated as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the "no trash / no restore" exclusion explicitly bounded so restore is not expected in this increment? [Assumption, Spec §Exclusiones]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are production mail-service dependency requirements documented versus dev console-simulation behavior? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK032 - Is "pendiente / activo inicial" terminology for the reopen target used consistently without conflict with "en progreso"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is a requirement and acceptance-criteria ID scheme (FR-xxx / SC-xxx / HU-xx) established and applied consistently for traceability? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
